challenge_tests.background: One final black-to-white transfer; no reverse experiment during development
challenge_tests.capture_session: Not a valid independent challenge: dates confounded with class and preparation unknown; descriptive counts only
challenge_tests.magnification: Two development transfer folds; final holdout by folder tag excluding four ambiguous tags from subgroup scores only
challenge_tests.shortcut_controls: Phase 4 metadata-only and background-only models use the same development folds

evaluation_group_rule: volume x background x folder magnification; broad blocks, not independent preparations
holdout_access: All images visually audited in Phase 1. No white-image feature design, mask review, tuning, training, calibration, or model selection after this freeze. Score locked winner once in Phase 6; preserve predictions. Any later change requires a new exploratory result with disclosed reuse.
leakage_rules: Fit scalers, PCA, feature selectors, learned preprocessing and class weights on each training fold only
Split before tiles/crops/augmentation; descendants inherit source membership; aggregate tiles to one image prediction
Known same-scene pair stays together; unknown overlap across blocks cannot be ruled out
No date, filename, path, EXIF or background tags as inputs to the visual classifier
Do not calibrate probabilities or claim verified confidence without independent calibration data
membership_rule: black -> development; white -> final holdout; never randomly split photographs

metrics.balanced_accuracy: Mean class recall; undefined when any true class missing
metrics.binary: Map seven-class argmax to 0=pure, >0=adulterated; sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN), specificity=TN/(TN+FP); undefined denominators -> null
metrics.volume_mae_pp: Mean absolute difference between predicted and true volume class; not continuous concentration estimation

preparation_evaluation.reason: One conservative group per class; holding one out removes its training class. Independent preparation count is unknown.

scope: Internal capture-condition transfer; unseen preparations not evaluated

selection.early_stopping: Use a preregistered fixed epoch schedule; do not use outer validation fold for checkpoint selection
selection.final_fit: Refit locked pipeline on all black images; white images never fitted
selection.primary_metric: mean of two development-fold seven-class macro_f1 values
selection.tie_break: If within 0.005 macro F1, prefer fewer fitted parameters, then shorter measured training time

uncertainty: No confidence intervals claiming independent photos or preparations; report two fold scores/range and condition-block counts descriptively
